title: ISO 20022 Reference Bindings (BPO subset)
license_note: ISO 20022 message definitions, business components, and data elements are published free-of-use and free-of-distribution by the Registration Authority (SWIFT) via iso20022.org. This file references their official identifiers and names and paraphrases descriptions in our own words; authoritative definitions live in the ISO 20022 Financial Repository. Only items BPO properties actually reference are listed.

messages.name: SecuritiesSettlementTransactionInstruction
messages.description: Instructs the receiver to settle a securities transaction; carries the parties, account, financial instrument, quantity, amount, trade and settlement dates, and conditions.

messages.name: SecuritiesSettlementTransactionStatusAdvice
messages.description: Reports the current processing status of a previously instructed settlement transaction, including matched / pending / settled / cancelled / failed states and reason codes.

messages.name: SecuritiesSettlementTransactionConfirmation
messages.description: Confirms that a settlement transaction has been settled, including the actual quantity and amount settled and the effective settlement date.

messages.name: SecuritiesSettlementTransactionGenerationNotification
messages.description: Notifies that a settlement instruction has been generated by the system (typically by an FMI in response to an upstream trade or corporate-action event).

messages.name: IntraPositionMovementInstruction
messages.description: Instructs a movement of securities within an account without a change of beneficial owner — e.g. blocking for collateral, hold-and-release for encumbrance, or earmarking for a pending settlement.

messages.name: SubscriptionMultipleOrder
messages.description: Orders the subscription (issuance / first-acquisition) of one or more investment-fund units; the inward leg by which units enter the system.

messages.name: RedemptionMultipleOrder
messages.description: Orders the redemption (return / cancellation) of one or more investment-fund units; the outward leg by which units leave the system.

components.name: PartyIdentification
components.description: Identification of a party — name, identifier (BIC / LEI / other), country, address — used in any of the roles a party plays within a transaction (issuer, owner, deliverer, receiver, intermediary, etc.).

components.name: SecuritiesAccount
components.description: Identification of a securities account, including the account identifier and the party operating it. The account is the holding unit at which positions are recorded.

components.name: FinancialInstrument
components.description: Description of a financial instrument — its identifier (typically ISIN), its class, currency of denomination, and other defining attributes.

components.name: SettlementDetails
components.description: Container for the settlement parameters of a transaction — settlement system, settlement date, parties, account, conditions, and operational flags.

components.name: TransactionStatus
components.description: Status of a transaction — pending, matched, settled, cancelled, rejected, failed — together with reason codes that explain the current state.

elements.name: SettlementTransactionIdentification
elements.description: Unique identifier of a settlement transaction within the settlement system; the join key for status reports, confirmations, and cancellations.

elements.name: SettlementDate
elements.description: The date on which a settlement is intended to occur or has occurred.

elements.name: TradeDate
elements.description: The date on which the underlying trade was struck (typically earlier than the SettlementDate).

elements.name: SettlementAmount
elements.description: The monetary amount to be settled, expressed as a value with a currency.

elements.name: SettlementQuantity
elements.description: The quantity of the financial instrument to be settled, expressed either as face value (nominal) or as a unit count.

elements.name: PartyRole
elements.description: The functional role a party plays in a transaction or arrangement — e.g. issuer, holder, custodian, validator, deliverer, receiver, intermediary, minter. Expresses the party's position with respect to the transaction or asset, distinct from the party's identity (which is carried by PartyIdentification).
